module purpose: neorv32_cpu_cp_cfu stores four 32-bit CSR words in an internal memory, returns an addressed stored word on csr_rdata_o, and, when start_i and rtype_i permit, latches rs1_i and rs2_i, updates internal state from funct3_i and the stored words, and drives result_o and valid_o.

use-case flows.value: 32-bit CSR word written into one of four stored locations selected by csr_addr_i
addressed stored CSR word returned on csr_rdata_o
accepted operation request that captures rs1_i and rs2_i and sets the internal done state
stored state and result updated from the latched operands, funct3_i, and a selected stored CSR word
computed result and completion status selected onto result_o and valid_o by rtype_i and funct3_i
stored CSR words and internal operation state forced to zero while rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.concept: Four stored 32-bit CSR words that are reused by the computation and returned by CSR reads
conceptual assets.reasoning: The configure flow stores csr_wdata_i into key_mem at line 179 when csr_we_i is asserted at line 178. The read-out flow returns the addressed stored word at line 185, and the operate flow reuses a selected stored word through tmp_z at lines 236-237 and tmp_r at line 238. Integrity is Established because corrupting a stored word changes both CSR readback and the computed result; availability is Established because a written word is retained in key_mem until it is read out or selected for the computation.

conceptual assets.concept: Latched data operands captured from rs1_i and rs2_i for a started computation
conceptual assets.reasoning: When the start condition is accepted at line 204, rs1_i and rs2_i are stored into xtea.opa and xtea.opb at lines 205-206. The operate flow then reads those stored values to initialize or combine state at line 214, to form tmp_a/tmp_b/tmp_x/tmp_y at lines 232-235, and finally to compute xtea.res at lines 222-224. Integrity is Established because wrong captured operands make the later state and reported result incorrect; availability is Established because, once captured, these stored operands must remain available until the computation uses them.

conceptual assets.concept: Stored arithmetic state word that is initialized or updated and then selects which stored CSR word is mixed into the computation
conceptual assets.reasoning: Inside the operate flow, xtea.sum is written from xtea.opa at line 214 or updated from its previous value at lines 216 and 218 when xtea.done(0) is set at line 211. That stored state is then used to select a key_mem entry at lines 236-237 and is mixed directly into tmp_r at line 238. Integrity is Established because corrupting this state changes both the selected stored word and the computed result; availability is Established because the updated state must be preserved until the selection and arithmetic at lines 236-238 read it.

conceptual assets.concept: Computed operation result word for the supported funct3_i result-producing modes
conceptual assets.reasoning: When xtea.done(0) is true, xtea.res is written from tmp_b and tmp_r at lines 222 and 224. The report flow then forwards xtea.res to result_o for the four funct3_i values listed at line 248, via line 249 in the rtype_i = r3type_c branch at line 245. Integrity is Established because corruption changes the reported computation result; availability is Established because the stored result must remain deliverable on result_o whenever that reporting branch is selected.

conceptual assets.concept: Accepted-operation status and completion flag used to qualify result reporting
conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow sets the internal status only when line 204 is true, with xtea.done(0) asserted at line 207. The status is then shifted at line 201, gates the state and result updates at line 211, and is reported on valid_o at line 250 for the four funct3_i values listed at line 248 in the rtype_i = r3type_c branch. Integrity is Established because a wrong status can mark stale or absent data as valid, or suppress a produced result; availability is Established because, after an accepted start, the stored status must become observable on valid_o under the implemented reporting condition.
